$comment: Questions the setup skill (and legacy sync.mjs) ask the user on first install. Answers go into ~/.claude/settings.local.json's env block. Re-run interactively via /tip-sync:setup or `node sync.mjs configure`. Adding a question here makes it auto-prompted on next setup.

questions.name: CLAUDE_PRUNE_BASE
questions.prompt: Base branch(es) for git worktrees — pick every base your repos use; the SessionEnd auto-prune hook prunes a worktree when its branch is merged into ANY selected base
questions.$note: Stored as a comma-separated list, e.g. "dev,master". Consumers (worktree-manager prune) split on comma.

questions.name: JIRA_USERNAME
questions.prompt: Your Tipalti Jira username (the part before @tipalti.com)

questions.name: JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN
questions.prompt: Jira personal access token — create one at <JIRA_URL>/secure/ViewProfile.jspa → Personal Access Tokens

questions.name: CONFLUENCE_USERNAME
questions.prompt: Your Tipalti Confluence username (typically same as Jira)

questions.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
questions.prompt: AWS access key ID (skip if you don't need AWS CLI from Claude)

questions.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
questions.prompt: AWS secret access key (skip if you don't need AWS CLI from Claude)

questions.name: CORALOGIX_DEV_API_KEY
questions.prompt: Coralogix Dev workspace API key (skip if you don't use the coralogix-dashboards or tip-health skills)
